text: So you agree I should get insurance then?

I hear your point. According to the National Health Accounts Estimates for 2022–23, households paid about 43% of total health spending in India directly out of pocket. IRDAI's 2024–25 report shows that of roughly 3.7 crore health claims handled, 87% were paid. Those figures illustrate how many expenses are covered through insurance. What concerns do you have about the cost of premiums versus potential out‑of‑pocket expenses?
